snippet.title: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes - Quest & Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vestiges: Fallen Tribes is a strategy game with autobattler mecanics available now on Quest & Steam (PC & PCVR).

• Get the game on Quest : 
https://www.meta.com/fr-fr/experiences/vestiges-fallen-tribes/7767930589976238/?require_login=true
• Get the game on Steam : 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511780/Vestiges_Fallen_Tribes/

Vestiges: Fallen Tribes is a unique blend of strategy, board game mechanics, and autobattler gameplay. Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic board game where your tactical decisions shape the outcome of every battle. As a tribe leader, you’ll use a deck of cards to summon and command animated units in a series of challenging, tactical battles.

Vestiges: Fallen Tribes is also available on Steam and VR compatible for equipped players.

• Join Discord : https://discord.gg/wanadevstudio-738367550886379592
• Vestiges: Fallen Tribes X :  https://x.com/vestiges_game
• WanadevStudio X: https://x.com/WanadevStudio  
• WanadevStudio Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100063962403745
• WanadevStudio Instagram :   https://www.instagram.com/wanadevstudio/ 
• Vestiges: Fallen Tribes website : https://www.vestiges-fallen-tribes.com/
